name: GhostBadge
description: Headless compact status and metadata label. useGhostBadge owns styling-hook bindings; GhostBadge is the thin unstyled span. Themed visual props live on @ghostvue/themes.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Short status or metadata text and optional decorative icon content. Icon-only use needs real hidden text (GhostVisuallyHidden), not aria-label on the span.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The native span after mount; null before mount and after unmount.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: Optional decorative icon content inside the default slot.

keyboard.Tab: Does not land on the badge. The component is not a tab stop and adds no key handling.
